text:
Emily: acme-corp just escalated — their p95 for /v1/text.generate jumped from ~120ms to ~420ms after the deploy last night. They provided traces and a repro. This is impacting a customer workflow. Can someone triage?

DeployBot: deployed inference-runtime@v2.14.3 (rev a1b2c3) at 2798760000. Change: default continuous-batching enabled with batch_timeout_ms=200.

Mia: oncall here, looking. @Josh can you pull the panels for api.p95 and the raw histograms for /v1/text.generate for acme-tenant? Which panel are they looking at? :eyes:

Josh: quick check — the dashboard panel most customers look at is a rollup quantile panel (1m rollup). That panel is showing a modest bump. However, raw histograms (we have a diagnostic panel) show a small number of long-tail requests after the deploy. I suspect a mismatch between rollup-treated quantiles and raw histograms.

Raj: I queried the raw buckets across hosts for model=redwood-large and tenant=acme. Query used: 
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(api_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/text.generate",tenant="acme"}[5m])) by (le))
```
The result shows p95 ~420ms for the window where the deploy was active. Looking at bucket counts, there are spikes in the 0.5–2s buckets on a small subset of hosts. Not global, but enough to push quantiles.

Paul: runtime note — v2.14.3 enabled `batch_on_demand` with batch_timeout_ms defaulted to 200. For low QPS tenants, that increases single-request latency since the runtime waits up to the timeout to fill a batch. We intended 50ms but config propagation used 200ms. That explains intermittent long tails when KV cache misses force model work.

Yana: acme is unhappy and wants a fast mitigation. They asked if we can either pin them to a smaller model variant or disable batching for their tenant.

Mia: proposed mitigations (short list):
1) Tenant override to disable batching or set batch_timeout_ms=50 for acme.
2) Hotfix rollback of v2.14.3 if config fix is non-trivial.
3) Update dashboard panels to use raw histogram quantile for incident analysis and add annotation about rollup vs raw differences.

Raj: I can apply a tenant override. Command (internal):
```
rbctl tenant update acme --set runtime.batch_timeout_ms=50 --set runtime.batch_enabled=true
```
I'll apply this to prod now and monitor.

Emily: can you also share a minimal repro so support can confirm with acme? They provided a curl that reproduces the slow tail: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY" -H "X-Batch-Timeout: 200" -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate -w "\nTIME_TOTAL:%{time_total}\n"
```
If you run that repeatedly at low QPS (1r/s) you see some requests ~0.4s+.

Paul: confirmed that at low QPS a 200ms batch timeout increases observed p95; if the KV cache is cold the request does full inference and latency jumps. We're rolling the tenant override.

Raj: override applied at 2798765520. I'll feed metrics into the incident channel. Added a temporary alert rule: p95(api_latency, route="/v1/text.generate", tenant="acme") > baseline*3 for 5m.

Josh: updated the debug dashboard to show both rollup-quantile and raw histogram_quantile side-by-side and added a short note in the panel: "rollup uses precomputed aggregates; use raw histogram for incident quantile derivation." Also added an annotation at 2798760000 marking the v2.14.3 deploy.

Yana: acme confirmed test runs — p95 dropped back close to previous levels (~130ms) after the tenant override. They asked for a permanent fix so this doesn't recur.

Mia: longer-term action items:
- Fix config propagation so batch_timeout_ms default is 50ms (Paul)
- Add per-tenant default override on deploys (Raj)
- Educate support on how rollup vs raw panels differ (Josh + Emily)
- Consider making batch_timeout_ms a runtime-configurable flag exposed in Console (Product)

Raj: I kicked a rollback job as a precaution (job id rollback-2798765600) to ensure prod defaults are safe while we patch config propagation.

DeployBot: rollback job rollback-2798765600 started at 2798765588.

Paul: patch for config propagation submitted (PR #4521). Will push to canary after CI.

Mia: thanks all. Closing loop: override + rollback brought p95 for acme back to acceptable range. I'll follow up with a short incident summary for all-hands. :white_check_mark:

Emily: thanks team — acme is happy with the quick rollback and tenant override. They want us to document the tenant override option in support runbooks.

Josh: note for observability team — add a runbook snippet to clarify which panels to use during latency incidents (raw histogram quantile vs rollup).

Raj: monitoring shows p95 back to ~130ms at 2798765642. Rolling to resolved unless anyone sees continued anomalies. :shipit:
